verdict.rationale: Fireflies documents team privacy settings and a Rules Engine that gives admins control over meeting access and privacy. Super Admins get full workspace meeting access, audit logs are available via API, and transcripts can be shared with email recipients with an optional expiry. Meetings can also be organized into channels/folders. missing for 10: evidence of private-by-default notes, granular link- and folder-level permission controls, admin visibility specifically into what has been shared and with whom, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
